task.description: Write comprehensive test specifications and test suites for all 14 WASM-* requirements. Create test spec files in tests/specs/ covering: Wasmtime integration (module loading, compilation), module ABI contract (stable interfaces), source compilation job (build process, error handling), compile caching (cache hits/misses, reproducibility), import whitelist (enforcement, rejection of unauthorized imports), filesystem access prevention, memory isolation, fuel limits (instruction counting), memory caps (allocation limits), timeout enforcement (wall-clock), host API parity with Lua, instance pooling (reuse, cleanup), hot reload (version management, concurrent updates). Tests must be integration tests against real backend (no mocks per DIRECTIVE T-1).
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/WASM-01-14.md written with all test cases
Test cases cover all MUST and SHOULD requirements
Each test case has clear acceptance criteria and expected outcomes
No MSW mocks, no HTTP mocking — all tests are E2E against real backend

result.summary: Created comprehensive test specification for all 14 WASM-* requirements covering Wasmtime integration, module ABI, compilation pipeline, caching, reproducibility, capability sandboxing, memory isolation, resource limits (fuel, memory, timeout), host API parity, instance pooling, and hot reload.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER for implementation and execution
